name: player_create_from_names_at_pose_get_state
description: Player::CreateFromNamesAtPoseGetState calls Player::CreateFromNamesAtPose with aiNetId forced to zero and returns the newly appended save-state tail on success, or null on failure.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Player bootstrap/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x421ea0 validates the fastcall spawn-position pointer in ECX, template name in EDX, stack yaw/object-name arguments, call to Player::CreateFromNamesAtPose with aiNetId forced to 0, and success-mask return of g_PlayerSaveStateListTail or null.
